description.value: Trackstand Cycleworks is an intimate bike repair studio in Vancouver's Chinatown, specialising in precision wheelbuilding, fixed-gear and single-speed builds, and comprehensive tune-up packages. The shop takes a transparent, process-driven approach—customers receive a clear assessment and estimate before any work begins, and are kept updated as the job progresses. It draws a devoted following among East Vancouver commuters and fixed-gear riders looking for expert, unhurried craftsmanship.

address.value: 273 Union St, Vancouver, BC V6A 2Z9, Canada

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 93m; stands (4 spaces) at 94m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Trackstand Cycleworks is a legitimate, active bike repair studio in Vancouver's Chinatown with a detailed services menu (tune-ups, wheel building, drivetrain work, fixed-gear specialty). The booking workflow ('Book a Service Now', structured request→assessment→estimate→approval process) indicates an appointment-based model; no explicit mention of walk-in triage, pump access, urgent drop-in help, or any touring-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content. OSM provides no street address or phone; the website mentions 'Chinatown' as a neighbourhood but lists no street address either.
concerns: No street address in OSM tags or on the website — only 'Chinatown' mentioned as a neighbourhood; cyclists will need to locate the shop via Google Maps or Instagram.
No phone number in OSM or on the website; contact is primarily via online service request form or email.
Appointment-based workflow may not accommodate spontaneous drop-in requests from passing touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A verified, professionally operated bike repair shop in Vancouver's Chinatown with a clear services menu and active online booking. Useful to touring cyclists needing mechanical work, though the appointment-based model and absence of a listed street address should be noted in the directory.
